question: Parity growth by CUBIC-FROM-A-KNOT's joining policy with the fresh count of every new junction left to a count rule: which counts keep it running, what each rule builds, what blind and random counts do, and whether the cap of three or any distance-read criterion singles out a number.

definitions.demand: number of joins of the next round taking a distinction from the junction
definitions.surplus: fresh distinctions beyond the demand; each becomes an offshoot
definitions.stall: a round in which some junction is in more groups than it has loose distinctions

public_inputs.code: freelib.py (sha256 7f9ef5f67852b35fdd816e4a04f7fe3df2998d611e792ed9e0a44cba8f46e7a5), ideals.py (sha256 54b70d28ae23458a59119421276d772ac9276d85ffcddfcbc94c3528ba7a8269), bonds.py (sha256 485a832039d0b6a487153ac53ae3b64c53d9779c9e7cec986fcf207593873438), job.py (sha256 d7f4ebf4d5d9cfa4eab7617008c5e7b1920c7deb0481bda79b542673d5e6f21c), merge.py (sha256 45f75e391ff6e606805514511617a4a43cb650edc044cfec84154c7b71ab61ea), checks.py (sha256 1ecc145d3ca5b721185081716efb88a721d1c70d2716d5ac780d9f213fb2bf55)
public_inputs.reused: bonds.py's threshold reader follows BOND-NEXT-JOIN-20261117-001 section 3

forbidden_inputs: Changing cases, rules, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
primary_observable: G and P1-P9 of research/FRESH-COUNT-20261118-001/preregistration.md, scored by merge.py.
cheapest_meaningful_control: checks.py gates: the predecessor's rounds and its referee's variants, GF(2) implied parity, mutants for the ideal checker, bond distances from the allowed states, the reader on N^3, a planted forced distinction.

predictions.P1: uniform uncapped: survives iff c = a; stall rounds 2/4/3
predictions.P2: capped: survives iff c = a = 3; c = a >= 4 stalls at round 4
predictions.P3: fewest gives 2^a; axis, inherit give N^a; balance stalls (round 2 for a >= 4, within 6 for a = 3)
predictions.P4: ideal check passes on every non-stalling run
predictions.P5: blind: at most 10% not stalled by round 10 per cell
predictions.P6: surplus: no stall, no forced bit, unclosed share rises with q, median last-round offshoots >= 3 for q >= 0.2
predictions.P7: fewest after hand-over: constant offshoots per round = first-round offshoots with demand 1; crossed starts keep a chains
predictions.P8: reader exact on uniform stages; on 2^a stages exact except the round a-1 stage (also reads all loose bits); at least one misread on mixed stages
predictions.P9: capped = uncapped iff no uncapped group of four or more

decision_rules.each prediction: holds or fails as scored by merge.py

stop_rule: One run; read-out; proofs; referee hand-off; report.
runtime: 8 workers through scripts/longrun.py, 15 to 30 minutes expected

amendments.change: job.py summary() raised KeyError on the closing round of surplus runs (its log entry has no capped-policy comparison because no round was formed); 378 surplus cases errored. Fixed to skip that entry; no case, rule, measured quantity, prediction or decision rule changed. The first run (runs/fresh-count) was stopped and the census relaunched whole in runs/fresh-count-2.
